critical_gaps.title: 旧算法全流程 orchestrator 离线 replay
critical_gaps.production_effect: Prove that one state machine interprets initialization through archive in the mature order.
critical_gaps.next_package: Add a historical-replay-only legacy 45/13 orchestrator binder.
critical_gaps.done_when: A single replay explains every stage, exact evidence consumed, hold reason, and next action without promoting replay to real acceptance.
critical_gaps.execution_boundary: offline replay only; no COM, route, write, PostgreSQL, release, or import

critical_gaps.title: 生产 component-QC evaluator 与 0613 拟合策略矩阵
critical_gaps.production_effect: Replace historical/manual QC ambiguity with canonical per-analyzer inputs for CO2/H2O fitting.
critical_gaps.next_package: Implement reviewed production QC evaluation and the 0613 multi-strategy no-write fit selector.
critical_gaps.done_when: Every fit input has component-matched QC, physical supersede/reject reasons, anchor roles, and a no-write candidate decision.
critical_gaps.execution_boundary: calc first; no coefficient write in evaluator or strategy selection

critical_gaps.title: 统一系数受控写入、读回与短复验闭环
critical_gaps.production_effect: Close the gap between accepted coefficients and per-device post-write evidence.
critical_gaps.next_package: Unify old-value snapshot, authorization, write, GETCO readback, rollback, and short reverify.
critical_gaps.done_when: Write success and validation success are reported separately for S1-S9 and SENCOA/B as applicable.
critical_gaps.execution_boundary: explicit authorization; paced writes; readback required; no implicit overwrite

critical_gaps.title: 新算法 47/14 点 live mature-queue 接入
critical_gaps.production_effect: Move the reviewed absorption profile from dry-run handoff to live use without forking the physical route.
critical_gaps.next_package: Add a separately authorized profile-to-mature-queue live adapter.
critical_gaps.done_when: 47 CO2 and 14 H2O points run through the same 0620/0621 runners; only fit input/R0/write contracts differ.
critical_gaps.execution_boundary: do not modify legacy 45/13 default or mature point-internal route logic

critical_gaps.title: PostgreSQL 18 真实受控入库
critical_gaps.production_effect: Persist released calibration evidence with SN/device_code identity and protocol-ID aliases.
critical_gaps.next_package: Implement the authorized transaction executor behind archive closure and dry-run validation.
critical_gaps.done_when: Schema, uniqueness, preview, transaction, readback, rollback, and import lineage pass before database_import_allowed becomes true.
critical_gaps.execution_boundary: no import from route, fit, replay, or no-write evidence alone

critical_gaps.title: 最终 simulation/replay/parity/resilience 验收套件
critical_gaps.production_effect: Demonstrate program-level closure without confusing offline evidence with real acceptance.
critical_gaps.next_package: Run the frozen legacy replay plus entrypoint, mature-route, fit-parity, writer, archive, and DB-lock suites.
critical_gaps.done_when: All offline suites pass and every artifact retains not_real_acceptance_evidence=true.
critical_gaps.execution_boundary: offline evidence cannot unlock formal release, database import, or live execution

critical_gaps.title: 真机批次 acceptance（设备可用时）
critical_gaps.production_effect: Provide the only valid final evidence that the complete production chain works on a real batch.
critical_gaps.next_package: Run a separately authorized 1-6 analyzer legacy batch, then a new-algorithm batch after its live handoff closes.
critical_gaps.done_when: Continuous mature routes, fitting, controlled writes, reverify, archive, and PostgreSQL import close with real evidence.
critical_gaps.execution_boundary: requires explicit hardware authorization; not part of this offline package
